companyFieldUpdates.description: Vertical Bridge REIT, LLC is a private U.S. wireless-infrastructure owner and operator providing build-to-suit and colocation capacity across towers, rooftops, utility structures, billboards and other communications sites. The company reports more than 500,000 sites, including more than 18,000 towers, serving wireless carriers and other communications tenants nationwide. DigitalBridge has invested since 2014 and completed a controlling-stake recapitalization in October 2021. La Caisse entered at a disclosed 30% stake in 2019; its current percentage is not publicly disclosed. KKR completed a US$1.5 billion equity investment through its core infrastructure strategy in 2026, while DigitalBridge and La Caisse remained investors; KKR's exact fund, affiliate and percentage are not public. InfraBridge is a DigitalBridge infrastructure-investment business unit rather than a direct owner. Towers, sites, portfolios and financing SPVs remain assets rather than separate PortCos. No later platform sale or current-sponsor exit was identified through August 23, 2026; SoftBank's announced acquisition of DigitalBridge is a manager-level transaction and not a direct transfer of Vertical Bridge.
